We need DBE for formula C7H3O5SCl. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring halogens as H). For halogens (Cl) treat as H. So effective H = H + halogens = 3 +1 =4. No N. So DBE = C - (H_eff)/2 +1 = 7 - 4/2 +1 = 7 -2 +1 =6. Also O and S do not affect. So DBE =6. Provide integer.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. Might still call retrieve_dbe_formula for completeness. Use tool.
